== Summary ==
Slip “•Reflection” cut unchanged from page 4 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF file created 6 October 2023), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 1290, 581, 1575)). Version [[Reflection (V)#Source formats|Reflection (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
